title: Vertical sentence card: two or three staggered columns read right to left, a numbered red block
use: A line of narration or dialogue as a beat, read top-down; up to three short columns.

ground.note: ground tone of the card: black, paper white or signal red (style groundTones)

stagger.note: each column starts lower by this x H

line{i}.note: column i, read right to left

relations: Columns read right to left and each starts lower than the last.
A sentence longer than the column budget is split into another column, never run off the frame.

provenance.corpus: Nocturne Corridor (夜想回廊) experiment: our own original fictional anime set in the shinbo style pack's grammar, first pass and reviewed final
provenance.method: Geometry taken from the final round's HTML/CSS as fractions of W and H; text sizes and colours chosen so the final passed the browser check (contrast with text hidden, ink overlap, collage alpha, off-canvas). All copy is original.
measured: first pass: 会看见自己的背影。 in one 118px column from 290px ran 400px past the bottom (off-canvas); final split it into a third column
provenance.summary: Nocturne Corridor c04 first pass and final
